Kolkata. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 30 days.

Experienced finance professional focused on accounting operations, compliance and process improvements using Tally and tax tools.

Senior Accountant, Meesho — Aug 2021 - Present
Managed month-end closings for multiple seller cohorts using Tally, reconciling payments and adjusting ledger discrepancies. Implemented a standardized TDS calculation checklist that reduced TDS reconciliation time by ~30%, and coordinated quarterly TDS filings with vendors. Collaborated with cross-functional teams in Jira and Confluence to track accounting issues and document resolution steps. Supported internal audits by providing detailed TDS and ledger reports, and assisted in GST-related queries from sellers.

Finance Executive, CartNest — Aug 2019 - Jul 2021
Handled daily bookkeeping and ledger maintenance in Tally, processed vendor invoices and prepared GST-compliant tax invoices. Calculated and prepared TDS schedules for monthly payments, ensuring timely remittance and filing. Led a project to streamline GST invoice workflows, improving invoice clearance times and reducing GST input mismatches. Used Jira to log finance tasks and Confluence to maintain SOPs for GST and TDS processes.

Skills: Tally, GST, TDS, Jira, Confluence, Agile

Education: MCA, Symbiosis
